```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(reticulate)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)


combined<-read.csv("fitting_mci_doc_cod/mci_doc_combined.csv")
```

##summary stats and plots 
```{r summarizing data}
#checking how many states are represented , finding out all states are
statetable<-combined%>%group_by(state_abbrev)%>%count()

#checking out how many unique facilities are represented, 1089 are 
facilitiestable<-combined%>%group_by(facilityid)%>%count()

#reorganizing death date as a Date str 
str(combined$death_date_dt)

combined$death_date_dt<-as.Date(combined$death_date_dt)

str(combined$death_date_dt)

#comparing # of mortality records across years 
combined<-combined%>%mutate(year=year(death_date_dt))

deaths_by_year<-combined%>%group_by(year)%>%count()


ggplot(combined, aes(x =year, y = fct_reorder(state_abbrev, year, .fun = min, .desc = TRUE))) +
  geom_tile(fill = "black", width = 1, height = 0.75) + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1996, 2024, by = 4)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),     
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),       
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "lightgray"), 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Coverage of Incarcerated Mortality Data by State", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "State"
  )

```
